principle: Positive records state desired image content. Negative terms are activated only by an applicable production condition or an explicit user exclusion.

generation_hygiene.activation: character-image generation where incidental marks are unrelated to the requested design

visible_limb_integrity.activation: arms, legs, wings, tentacles, or other articulated limbs are visibly framed

hand_or_paw_integrity.activation: a visible hand, paw, claw, or manipulator performs a readable action

tail_integrity.activation: the selected subject has a visible tail
terms: tail fused into a nearby form

held_prop_integrity.activation: the subject holds, wears, leans on, or otherwise contacts a prop

selected_render_profile.activation: a render profile is selected as the active medium grammar

selected_style_family.activation: a style family is selected as the active drawing grammar

observed_generation_failure.activation: a generated image exhibits a specific failure that should be corrected on retry

user_exclusion.activation: the user explicitly excludes a concept or presentation

semantic_exclusion_rule: Do not invent semantic exclusions; add them only when the user explicitly excludes them.
merge_rule: Merge only terms whose activation condition is true for the current generation.
applicability_rule: Remove inactive terms when the scene, anatomy, wardrobe, props, or selected medium changes.
